repeated_contracts.statement: Every route produces a deferred-call record = (callable identity, fixed positional, fixed keyword) consumed later. Four routes (capture, returned partial, partial-of-helper, partialmethod) store AST expressions and evaluate them in the CONSUMER's env/bindings; three routes (partial-of-spawn, methodcaller, Thread/Timer args) freeze literal|MISS at the PRODUCER. F1 is exactly the AST-carrying half; Thread inherits it when its target is a capture/partial record.

A frame must shadow names in BOTH the literal env and the bindings map. follow_helper does both (2241-2263); sweep_body masks bindings and uses empty env (2193-2199); the capture overlay updates env only (2336-2337); thread_start injects into bindings only (2299-2300, F5).

On unbindable arguments: follow_helper returns None and the body is swept as lead (2236-2237, 2396-2398); thread_start counts unparsed (2309-2310); capture overlay falls through with invocation env and reports observed (2335, F2); stored methodcaller with non-literal method falls through every branch silently (2312, then no matching kind).

Callable identity for factory returns is picked syntactically (last top-level def by name, 1646-1647; first top-level Return, 1648) or against module bindings (returned partial's wrapped name, 1657), never against the factory-local binding in effect at the return statement; the prefix replay (2338-2343) runs after identity is fixed (F3).

Refs sweep skips any value passed to Thread/Timer unconditionally (2550-2553); ownership is granted only when a recognized .start consumer exists (1666-1667 named, 2294-2297 inline). Any unrecognized consumer (.run F4, alias of inline-constructed .start, never-started thread) therefore yields no row and unparsed 0.

invariants.name: producer-time freeze
invariants.rule: A record that outlives its producing statement carries no AST to be evaluated later; every fixed argument and factory parameter is resolved at the producer's pre-statement snapshot into (literal|MISS, binding|parameter).

invariants.name: two-namespace mask
invariants.rule: Every name a frame binds (factory params, factory-cell locals from the prefix, inner params) masks BOTH env and bindings; unknown masks as LITERAL_MISS and {kind: parameter}, never by omission.

invariants.name: identity at effect
invariants.rule: Returned callable identity = factory-local binding in effect at the Return (post-prefix replay), including names wrapped by a returned functools.partial.

invariants.name: late globals
invariants.rule: Names not masked by any frame are read at the consumer: synchronous consumers (call, Thread.run, Timer.run) use the consumer statement snapshot; asynchronous consumers (Thread.start, Timer.start) read globals at an unbounded later time.

invariants.name: synthetic isolation
invariants.rule: Synthetic invocations never inject a source-spelled name; carry the resolved record on the synthetic node (F5).

invariants.name: downgrade not fallthrough
invariants.rule: Any bind/resolve failure on any route yields lead (sweep) or unparsed, never observed from an outer env and never silence.

invariants.name: bounded resolution
invariants.rule: Identity resolution and prefix replay of a factory carry an owner-id stack (like ctx['stack'] / class_method_info seen) so self-referential factories terminate.

invariants.name: single instant
invariants.rule: Producer literals and bindings are read at the same instant (pre-statement snapshot). Today assignment_binding reads env AFTER the statement's own module_binding update (2066-2074) but bindings BEFORE (1805-1811).

invariants.name: exemption iff ownership
invariants.rule: A Thread/Timer target is exempt from the refs lead sweep only when a recognized consumer followed it.

proposed_move.name: freeze the overlay, not the frame
proposed_move.summary: Unify all AST-carrying routes (capture, returned partial, partial-of-helper, partialmethod, and Thread/Timer targets that are such records) on the representation Thread args/methodcaller already use: at the producing statement, resolve a small overlay {param_or_cell_name: (literal|MISS, binding|{kind: parameter})} plus the identity node chosen from post-prefix bindings under an owner-id guard. At consumption, layer that overlay over the CONSUMER's env and bindings (which the capture branch already uses as its base at 2336), never over a producer-time copy of the whole env/bindings. Bind failure produces an overlay of MISS/parameter masks for every factory parameter instead of skipping the overlay.
proposed_move.synthesis: Compatible join of FinalBindingReview check 1 (snapshot at creation, LITERAL_MISS on failure, post-prefix identity) and SimplifyCapture's ClosureFrame, corrected on two points: base layer must be the consumer env (I4; SimplifyCapture freezes literal_env and binding_map at creation), and masks must cover bindings on BOTH success and failure paths (I2; V3 is on the success path, untouched by an env-only F2 fix).
proposed_move.cost: O(number of factory params + prefix-bound names) per record instead of O(|env|+|bindings|) per record; no new pass over cells.
proposed_move.partialmethod_note: class_method_info runs lazily at invocation with no class-definition env retained; either record the ClassDef statement's pre-statement snapshot reference in the class binding, or (sound, cheaper) treat any non-Constant partialmethod fixed argument as MISS (lead).
